title: MINARET Doctoral Network
field: Sociology of law; Islamic legal cultures
about: MINARET (A Sociology of Post-Imperial Islamic Legal Cultures), a Horizon Europe MSCA Doctoral Network coordinated by Lund University, is recruiting 15 doctoral candidates hosted by 11 European universities for a 48-month programme starting September 2027. Apply through each position's host vacancy by 31 January 2027.
requirements: Degree formally entitling the candidate to start a doctorate
No doctoral degree and no more than four years of full-time equivalent research experience
MSCA mobility rule: no more than 12 months residence/main activity in the host country in the 3 years before recruitment

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: Doctoral research programme (48 months, 'Sociology of law; Islamic legal cultures') -> objective 'Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis.'
Doctoral research -> objective 'Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities.'
